findings.location: s5-plan, Marrying legally tab, Australian Passport block
findings.issue: The D3 hedge got weaker in revision 2. Revision 1 told Australians to confirm 'which document you need and where it must be issued'. Revision 2 drops 'and where it must be issued' but keeps 'DFAT also issues CNIs in Australia'. Read together, this suggests a CNI issued in Australia will do. No official source says Portugal accepts one (F041, unconfirmed), and F036 itself warns that some authorities only accept CNIs issued in their own country. The page makes no explicit claim, so this is not a blocker, but it is a legal line by passport and the earlier hedge was stronger.
findings.evidence: "The Australian Embassy in Lisbon can issue a CNI, and DFAT also issues CNIs in Australia. Confirm with the Registo Civil or the Embassy of Portugal in Canberra which document you need."
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the revision 1 ending: "Confirm with the Registo Civil or the Embassy of Portugal in Canberra which document you need and where it must be issued." Or add F036's caveat after the DFAT clause: "DFAT also issues CNIs in Australia, but some countries accept only a CNI issued locally." FAQ 2 has no DFAT clause and can stay.
